title: China’s threats to invade Taiwan pose risks to PH
description: ON Nov. 7, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi told her country’s legislature that if China attacked Taiwan, it could be considered a “survival-threatening situation” for Japan and trigger a military response. China called her remark “not just dangerously provocative, but fundamentally perverse.”

title: Batanes: Our country’s Kinmen Island
description: FEW Filipinos are familiar with the historical, strategic and military significance of Kinmen Island to the Taiwanese people. Yet this small island has long symbolized Taiwan’s defiant stand against Chinese aggression under the most trying circumstances. If you look closely at the map below, Kinmen lies between Taiwan and China, but is closer to the southeastern coastline of the city of Xiamen, only 3 kilometers away from mainland China. Historically part of China’s southeastern Fujian province, Kinmen became Chiang Kai-shek’s fallback base as his Nationalists retreated from the mainland toward Taiwan as they were routed by the Communists.

title: SC Asset Appoints All Well Corp as Exclusive Global Sales Partner for STILL Sukhumvit 20 Condominium
description: BANGKOK, Nov. 28, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- SC Asset Corporation Public Company Limited has officially appointed All Well Corp Company Limited as its Exclusive Partner for international sales of STILL Sukhumvit 20, the company's new ultra-luxury flagship condominium situated in the heart of Sukhumvit - one of Bangkok's most vibrant and sought-after districts. This strategic partnership further elevates SC Asset's global presence and reinforces its outreach across key international markets, including mainland China, Myanmar, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and other emerging regions.

title: African Swine Fever Outbreak Hits Catalonia
description: Catalonia has closed the Collserola natural park after the first outbreak of African swine fever in Spain since 1994. The virus, harmless to humans but contagious to pigs, has led to pork import bans from countries including Taiwan, China, and Mexico.

title: How Japanese hard power diplomacy is on rise
description: Japan’s decision to deploy a medium-range missile unit on Yonaguni Island marks a major escalation in its efforts to deter China amid rising tensions over Taiwan and the Indo-Pacific

title: Anime event in Shanghai canceled after singer's show interrupted
description: Japan-related events in China have been canceled one after another amid growing backlash over Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's remarks on Taiwan.

title: The world this week | G20 Summit in South Africa, US-China talks on Taiwan, and Russia-Ukraine peace plan
description: From world leaders congregating in South Africa’s Johannesburg for the G20 Summit to China squabbling with Japan over Taiwan and announcing the construction of the world’s first floating artificial island with a nuclear-proof bunker – a lot has happened in the world this week.

title: China urges UK to uphold 'one-China principle' amid Taiwan dispute
description: China’s Foreign Minister Wang Yi on Friday urged the United Kingdom to uphold the “One-China” principle, amid Beijing’s sharp diplomatic tensions with Tokyo over Taiwan

title: Diplomatic Tensions Spike: China Appeals to UK Over Taiwan Policy
description: China's Foreign Minister Wang Yi urges Britain to adhere to the 'one-China' principle amidst tensions with Japan over Taiwan. Beijing aims to strengthen strategic ties and coordination with the UK, as discussions also cover Ukraine during a meeting with Britain's national security adviser, Jonathan Powell.

title: China calls on UK to uphold 'one-China' principle
description: China's Foreign Minister Wang Yi called on Britain on Friday to uphold the "one-China" principle, as Beijing seeks to rally support in its worst diplomatic dispute with Tokyo in years over democratically-governed Taiwan.
